purpose: Deterministically reconcile the completed 2019-2020 CME 6E MBP-10 design acquisition, decode only the frozen PRE/LATE source windows, and freeze an outcome-blind Stage 0B-D feature/source-quality ledger before any EURUSD outcome is opened.

authority_chain.registry_rule: The observed global SHA is audit evidence, not a future execution lock. Require the exact V14 272-row prefix, canonical validator PASS, only validator-clean unrelated appends, and the unchanged exact three-row HYP-002 history. Never append or modify the registry for this terminal parked ID.

segment_quality: Every used top-five depth denominator is finite and strictly positive.
All ts_event values are inside the exact half-open segment and are monotonic nondecreasing.
The final ts_event is no more than one second before the exact segment end.
No consecutive ts_event gap exceeds one second.
Metadata and all records resolve to the exact known 6E.v.0 instrument mapping for that file; partial/not_found/unknown mappings fail quality.
frozen_interpretation.pair_quality: Both PRE and LATE pass segment quality and LATE median best-ask minus best-bid is finite, nonnegative and no more than two 6E ticks (tick size 0.00005, Databento fixed-price scale 1e-9).
frozen_interpretation.feature_eligibility: After pair quality, I5_pre=median(PRE I5), I5_late=median(LATE I5), delta_I5=I5_late-I5_pre. The event is Stage0 eligible only when I5_late and delta_I5 are finite, nonzero, and have the same sign. This operationalizes the unchanged parent qualifier set without changing a threshold.
frozen_interpretation.stage0_gate_population: Use the final feature-eligible count for the >=209 and 2.0-5.0 events/week gates. Also report source-quality-paired count separately so source failure is not conflated with sign ineligibility.

fatal_gates: Exactly 658 unique canonical request identities and exactly 329 unique event pairs are represented.
Every identity is either one manifest/hash/DBN-validated nonempty raw file or explicit paid-completed, response-validated, retry-prohibited source-empty evidence.
PRE nonempty coverage >= 0.99, LATE nonempty coverage >= 0.99, paired nonempty-event coverage >= 0.99.
Final feature-eligible cadence is between 2.0 and 5.0 events per elapsed week inclusive.

No duplicate identity, noncanonical bound, unmanifested extra file, size/hash/record-count mismatch, unresolved paid request, unknown instrument, nonmonotonic ts_event, 2021-2022 source row, EURUSD path/read, outcome field, remote call or paid call exists.

required_outputs.feature_ledger: Exactly one deterministic row per 329 design event. Include identities, exact bounds, source-empty flags, record counts, hashes, segment and pair quality booleans/reason codes, I5_pre, I5_late, delta_I5, LATE median spread in ticks, feature eligibility and direction. Include no EURUSD/outcome/performance field.
required_outputs.manifest: Hash-bind the packet, prereg, source manifest, acquisition authority, live quote evidence, clock source, analyzer, tests, feature ledger and all 658 manifest-declared raw file hashes. Record counters, coverages, source-quality-paired count, feature-eligible count, cadence, gate-by-gate PASS/FAIL, deterministic failure reasons, prohibited-read counters fixed at zero, and final Stage0 verdict.
required_outputs.readout: Concise English evidence readout separating acquisition reconciliation, nonempty coverage, source-quality failures, sign/feature ineligibility, cadence and authority for the next stage. It must say no market edge verdict and no EURUSD outcome was opened.

red_first_acceptance_tests: Frozen formula/median/sign and quality-boundary tests cover exactly 30 records, one-second final staleness, one-second max gap, two-tick LATE median spread, zero denominator and equal/zero signs.
Hash/size/record mismatch, extra/unmanifested file, duplicate request/event segment, wrong bounds/year/schema/dataset/symbol/mapping and nonmonotonic ts_event fail closed.
Explicit source-empty evidence is represented but never quality/feature eligible; coverage calculations use 329 as denominator and paired coverage requires both nonempty segments.
Synthetic 209 eligible events over 104.428571 weeks pass the count and cadence gates; 208 fail; exact cadence boundaries are inclusive.
The analyzer rejects any path outside the exact D-side CME root and clock/prereg/task inputs, performs no network/client construction and imports no EURUSD/MT5 outcome source.
Running twice against an unchanged sealed snapshot yields byte-identical ledger and manifest except no wall-clock field is permitted in deterministic outputs.
prohibitions: Do not use Grok or any Grok skill/worker.
Do not read EURUSD prices, bars, ticks, trades, outcomes, PnL, PF, MFE, MAE, validation-period CME source, 2023+ data, or middle-window data.
Do not call Databento metadata/timeseries/batch/network APIs; DBNStore local decoding only.
Do not modify preregistration, registry, source acquisition evidence, raw DBN files, clock source, strategy thresholds, MQL5, MT5 or unrelated files.
Do not stage, commit, push, create a branch, worktree or clone.
next_authority: A verified Stage0 PASS freezes the feature ledger and permits the Lead Quant to create a separate pre-outcome Stage1 task packet before opening 2019-2020 EURUSD outcomes. Stage0 FAIL parks this exact ID and forbids Stage1, validation purchase and MQL5.
